SPECIFICALLY, THE COLLABORATION WILL HELP FULFILL THE CENTER'S NATIONAL MISSION OF SERVING AS THE NATION'S LEADING SOURCE OF AGRICULTURAL AND FOOD LAW RESEARCH AND INFORMATION, WITH A FOCUS ON AG LABOR, INDUSTRIAL HEMP, DISASTER ASSISTANCE, FARM BILL ISSUES AND IMPLEMENTATION, NATURAL RESOURCE AND ENVIRONMENTAL LAW, AND OTHER AG AND FOOD SYSTEM LEGAL ISSUES IMPACTING THROUGHOUT THE AGRICULTURAL SECTOR. ADDITIONALLY, IT WILL HELP USDA NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL LIBRARY BETTER SERVE ITS STAKEHOLDERS THROUGHOUT USDA AND BEYOND. THIS COLLABORATION ADDRESSES THE CRITICAL NATIONAL NEED FOR THE DEVELOPMENT AND DELIVERY OF AUTHORITATIVE, TIMELY, AND OBJECTIVE AGRICULTURAL AND FOOD LAW RESEARCH AND INFORMATION TO SERVE THE NATION'S VAST AGRICULTURAL COMMUNITY. AGRICULTURAL LAW AND FOOD LAW ARE DEFINED BROADLY TO INCLUDE NOT JUST LAND-BASED AGRICULTURE FOOD AND FIBER PRODUCTION AND SYSTEMS BUT ALSO SEAFOOD AND MARINE-BASED PRODUCTION VIA AQUACULTURE AND ENERGY ISSUES.

FOOD AND AGRICULTURAL LAW AND POLICY RESOURCES 2020 - TO PRODUCE AND WIDELY DISSEMINATE FOOD AND AGRICULTURAL LAW AND POLICY RESEARCH, INFORMATION, AND RESOURCES THROUGH PARTNERSHIPS DESIGNATED IN THE FY18 FARM BILL TO FURTHER THE DEVELOPMENT OF A COMPREHENSIVE FOOD AND AGRICULTURAL LIBRARY AND INFORMATION NETWORK. THE FOCUS OF THIS PARTNERSHIP IS TO RESEARCH AND DEVELOP RESOURCES AND INFORMATION ON REGULATORY MATTERS SUCH AS COMPLIANCE ISSUES AND APPEALS PROCESSES; TRANSACTIONAL ISSUES IMPACTING FARMERS, FOOD BUSINESSES, AND THE ORGANIZATIONS THAT SUPPORT THEM; SEAFOOD SUPPLY CHAINS AND GOVERNANCE; HEIRS' PROPERTY AND FARMLAND ACCESS; SELECTED TOPICS ON ENERGY AND AGRICULTURE; AND OTHER TOPICS INCLUDING PASTURE-BASED FARMING AND GRAZING SYSTEMS, PROVISIONS IN THE 2018 FARM BILL AND PLANT AND CELL-BASED FOODS. IN ADDITION, WITH THIS PARTNERSHIP WE WILL CONTINUE TO DISSEMINATE AND MAINTAIN EXISTING RESOURCES. WE ARE ALSO FOCUSING ON IMPROVING THE ACCESSIBILITY OF OUR RESOURCES, INCLUDING TRANSLATING KEY RESOURCES INTO SPANISH.

THE FOCUS OF THIS PARTNERSHIP IS TO RESEARCH AND DEVELOP RESOURCES AND INFORMATION ON LOCAL FOOD SYSTEMS AND FOOD ACCESS, FOOD SYSTEMS RESILIENCE, CLIMATE CHANGE, AND REGENERATIVE AGRICULTURE. IN ADDITION, WITH THIS PARTNERSHIP WE WILL IMPROVE THE ACCESSIBILITY OF OUR RESOURCES INCLUDING TRANSLATING TARGETED MATERIALS INTO SPANISH, AND CONTINUE TO DISSEMINATE AND MAINTAIN EXISTING RESOURCES.

SERVING THE NATION'S AG & FOOD STAKEHOLDERS: RESEARCH AND EDUCATION FOCUSED ON EVOLVING ISSUES IN FOOD, AG FINANCE AND ENVIRONMENTAL LAW - THE OBJECTIVE IS FOR THE NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL LAW CENTER, A UNIT OF THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS SYSTEM DIVISION OF AGRICULTURE, TO COLLABORATE WITH THE USDA AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH SERVICE, NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL LIBRARY. SPECIFICALLY, THE COLLABORATION WILL HELP FULFILL THE CENTER'S NATIONAL MISSION OF SERVING AS THE NATION'S LEADING SOURCE OF AGRICULTURAL AND FOOD LAW RESEARCH AND INFORMATION, WITH A FOCUS ON THE 2022 FARM BILL, CONSERVATION AND ENVIRONMENTAL LAW ISSUES, CLIMATE CHANGE AND AGRICULTURE DEVELOPMENTS, FARM FINANCE AND CREDIT, AGRICULTURAL TAXATION, DAIRY ISSUES, AND OTHER AG AND FOOD SYSTEM LEGAL ISSUES IMPACTING THROUGHOUT THE AGRICULTURAL SECTOR. ADDITIONALLY, IT WILL HELP USDA NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL LIBRARY BETTER SERVE ITS STAKEHOLDERS THROUGHOUT USDA AND BEYOND. THIS COLLABORATION ADDRESSES THE CRITICAL NATIONAL NEED FOR THE DEVELOPMENT AND DELIVERY OF AUTHORITATIVE, TIMELY, AND OBJECTIVE AGRICULTURAL AND FOOD LAW RESEARCH AND INFORMATION TO SERVE THE NATION'S VAST AGRICULTURAL COMMUNITY. AGRICULTURAL LAW AND FOOD LAW ARE DEFINED BROADLY TO INCLUDE NOT JUST LAND-BASED AGRICULTURE FOOD AND FIBER PRODUCTION AND SYSTEMS BUT ALSO SEAFOOD AND MARINE-BASED PRODUCTION VIA AQUACULTURE AND ENERGY ISSUES.

THE COLLABORATION SERVER (CS) WAS INITIALLY DEVELOPED TO SUPPORT THE SHARING OF LCA RESEARCH DATA AND MODELS BETWEEN RESEARCHERS IN DIFFERENT LOCATIONS, PROVIDING CENTRALIZED REPOSITORIES OF LCA RESOURCES WITH A ROBUST VERSION CONTROL WORKFLOW. IT WAS IMPLEMENTED AT THE END OF FY2018 AS THE FOUNDATIONAL TECHNOLOGY FOR THE LCA COMMONS WEB PORTAL. THE NAL HAS DEVELOPED AN EXPANDED SET OF USE CASES AND REQUIREMENTS FOR THE CS TECHNOLOGY OVER THE PAST 1.5 YEARS OF CONSISTENT USE AND STAKEHOLDER FEEDBACK FROM THE FEDERAL LCA RESEARCH COMMUNITY. ENHANCEMENTS TO DATA SHARING AND INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE WILL CONTINUE TO ADVANCE THE GOALS OF THE LCA COMMONS RESEARCH COMMUNITY TOWARDS CONSISTENT LCA METHODS AND ACCESS TO PUBLIC RESEARCH PRODUCTS.
